title: Job Row Carries The Request
description: A scheduled report job needs to remember exactly what was asked for — the from/to/groupBy/timeZone it was requested with — so it can be reproduced or audited later without guessing.
successCondition: POST /api/reporting/jobs with a specific, memorable set of values: from "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", to "2026-02-01T00:00:00.000Z", groupBy "month", timeZone "America/New_York". Querying report_jobs via `npm run db:psql` for the new row confirms from_date, to_date, group_by, and time_zone exactly match what was submitted (from_date/to_date compared as UTC instants) — none of the four values were normalized, defaulted, or altered on the way in.
hints: createReportJob (apps/api/src/modules/reporting/service.ts) stores the query fields directly on the ReportJob row before enqueueing the generation work — inspect the row immediately, you don't need to wait for it to become ready to check this.
select from_date, to_date, group_by, time_zone from report_jobs where id = '<id>'; is the whole check.
